descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Stockholm puts you in the captain's seat over the real Stockholm.

THE REAL STOCKHOLM
Real satellite, elevation and map data: Gamla stan, the Royal Palace, Stadshuset's three crowns, Katarinahissen, the Hotorget towers, Globen, Kaknastornet, Grona Lund, the Vasa Museum, Drottningholm, Vaxholm Fortress, Sigtuna, Skokloster and Uppsala. Arlanda with all three runways, Bromma and Uppsala Arna.

THE ARCHIPELAGO
Thousands of real islands from Vaxholm to Grinda and Ljustero, the Finland ferries in the ship lane, Waxholmsbolaget's boats, yachts on Lake Malaren and the fjards.

A LIVING CITY
Commuter trains and the green tunnelbana on their real tracks, the Djurgarden ferries on Saltsjon, cars on the real roads. At night the city lights up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances, traffic calls and your landing clearance.

ENGLISH AND SWEDISH
Switch every menu between English and Swedish in Settings.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar on Saltsjon, the Royal Palace and Gamla stan out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet with yokes and a twin-engine fighter.

ELEVEN MISSIONS
The Bromma city approach, the Malaren and Saltsjon run, through the archipelago, Uppsala and the castles, a fighter scramble from Arna, Stockholm by night and a city tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
